description: This file is a shell script (`git-instaweb.sh`) that provides command-line utilities for managing a web-based interface for Git repositories, known as 'git instaweb'. It includes functions for starting, stopping, and restarting web servers (such as lighttpd, Apache, WEBrick, or plackup) configured to serve gitweb, along with code for generating server configurations specific to each server type. The script also handles setting up CGI or PSGI environments, configuring server parameters like port, address binding, and document root, and optionally opening the web interface in a browser.

methods.name: resolve_full_httpd
methods.description: Resolves and sets the full path to the HTTP daemon executable based on the configured server type, and checks its existence.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts the web server configured for gitweb, including generating configuration files and handling server process.

methods.name: stop_httpd
methods.description: Stops the running web server, if any is running.

methods.name: httpd_is_ready
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP server has started successfully by attempting socket connections.

methods.name: configure_httpd
methods.description: Configures the server based on the current $httpd type by calling the appropriate configuration function.

methods.name: gitweb_conf
methods.description: Creates the main gitweb configuration Perl file.

methods.name: lighttpd_conf
methods.description: Generates configuration file for lighttpd to serve gitweb.

methods.name: apache2_conf
methods.description: Generates configuration for Apache HTTP Server to serve gitweb, including module loading and CGI/pass environment setup.

methods.name: webrick_conf
methods.description: Creates a WEBrick Ruby script to serve gitweb via a standalone Ruby server.

methods.name: mongoose_conf
methods.description: Creates configuration for the Mongoose web server.

methods.name: plackup_conf
methods.description: Generates a PSGI script to run gitweb with Plack.

methods.name: python_conf
methods.description: Creates a Python `http.server`-based script to serve gitweb via CGI.
